messages:
elena: Deploy-bot paused the staggered promotion for v5.2.0 during change window. Reason: dependency-manifest points to sidecar image not found in index; smoke tests 2/4 hit infra flakiness. CI run: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/210999 :eyes:
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: reason=manifest_dep_missing, missing_deps=[sidecar-logger@sha256:ffee0011], auto_retries=1
elena: logs snippet:
```
WARN manifest: dependency lookup failed for sidecar-logger@sha256:ffee0011
ERROR smoke: service-init failed: timed out waiting for ephemeral-config (30s)
```
sam: Hmm, sidecar build uploaded but index showed 202 earlier; mirror region didn't materialize the index key. We've seen this when the manifest author pushes sidecar after the main image, and the index cron lags.
product-release: Change window ends in 22m. If we wait for mirror propagation it's risky. What's last-known-good for the manifest set?
devops-lead: Options: (1) short hold (5m) and auto-retry, (2) manual-promote whole release using last-known-good manifest bundle, (3) rerun upload+CI for sidecar (may miss window). Risk/impact?
elena: last-known-good manifest bundle (bundle@20260315) references sidecar-logger@sha256:abcd1234 which was promoted to stable 3h ago. No regressions reported.
sam: If we manual-promote the bundle, we should annotate release notes and create a follow-up to rerun the sidecar CI and consider a targeted promote later. Also need a sign-off from product-release.
product-release: I'm OK with pinning to the previous bundle to avoid missing the window. Please include a note: "Pinned manifest bundle due to transient index propagation for sidecar image; follow-up CI scheduled."
devops-lead: Approving manual promote. Command: `deployctl promote --artifact bundle@20260315 --target=stable --reason "missing manifest dependency; avoid missing change window" --annotate "manual pin; follow-up TKT-8462"`
deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled by devops-lead. stable -> bundle@20260315. Release metadata updated.
elena: Change window unblocked. Creating TKT-8462: "Investigate manifest dependency index propagation & ordering; add guard for promotes when manifest refs unresolved" and assigning infra.
infra-bot: TKT-8462 created and linked to CI logs. Notifying infra-team.
sam: Follow-up plan: rerun upload+CI for sidecar-logger@ffee0011 after window; if clean, decide on targeted promote or leave pinned. If sidecar differs materially, product will advise on re-promote.
product-release: Add a release note snippet suggested: "Manifest bundle temporarily pinned to last-known-good due to transient index propagation for a sidecar image; follow-up CI and potential targeted promote planned."
elena: I'll update release notes and schedule the CI rerun at +30m. Closing thread for now — ping here when rerun finishes. :rocket:
